budget.note: One experiment with two dilation variants; no promotion to a weekly slot.

hypothesis: Under the official distance-weighted Tversky index (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m kernel), 1-px dilation of the recommended 37,647-dot file increases expected score because false negatives cost 4x false positives.
mechanism: Dilated neighbours fall inside the 3 px kernel of off-catalogue truth, raising TP and lowering FN; each added pixel costs only alpha=0.2 if it is a false positive.
named_non_fault_mimic: Digitisation halos and gravity/magnetic edge artefacts beside mapped faults (official scoring penalises these fully, because only new-fault ground truth counts; see DrivenData forum #11516).

holdout.label: HOLDOUT-DTI (proxy)
holdout.caveat: Raw and calibrated proxies disagree in direction. The calibrated variant assumes a hidden-truth size of 12,691 px fitted to the leaderboard ledger; the raw variant uses the 62,703-px SGMC truth count. The organizer's hidden-truth size is unknown. This experiment does not resolve the question.

leakage_canary.reason: No new feature was introduced; the experiment only changes dot count on a fixed output.
